items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. The 30-minute consultation and the estimate that follows are free, with no obligation to work with us.
Yes. We are happy to sign a non-disclosure agreement before you share detailed information about your idea or business.

items.q: What should I include in my message?
items.a: A short description of what you want to build, who it is for, any deadlines and your rough budget if you have one. Do not worry if you are unsure; we will ask the right questions.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside India?
items.a: Yes. We work with clients worldwide and schedule calls in your time zone.
